description_en: Submits a manifest editing task for an existing adaptive bitrate streaming (AUTO) packaging output to add or remove audio, video, or subtitle tracks to or from the master playlist without re-transcoding
description_zh: 调用本接口对已有的自适应（AUTO）码流打包产物提交Manifest编辑任务，向master播放列表添加或删除音频、视频、字幕轨道，无需重新转码
name: SubmitEditMediaManifestJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target video, used for authentication isolation and consistency verification
parameters.help_zh: 目标视频 ID，用于鉴权隔离与一致性校验
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en: The job ID of the target AUTO stream
parameters.help_zh: 目标 AUTO 流的 JobId
parameters.name: auto_stream_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the manifest edit template, which is returned after calling AddManifestEditTemplate. If specified, the output tracks are orchestrated based on the fixed Video, Audio, and Subtitle item configurations in the template
parameters.help_zh: ManifestEdit模板ID（AddManifestEditTemplate创建后返回）。传入时按模板中固定的Video/Audio/Subtitle三类Item配置编排输出轨道
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of audio tracks to be added, specified as a JSON string array. Each element contains:
Language: the audio language identifier.
Name: the display name of the track. If not specified, the default value is audio-{Language}.
AudioUrl: the URL of the audio file (OSS file URL)
parameters.help_zh:
待添加的音频轨道列表，JSON字符串数组。每个元素包含：
Language：音频语言标识。
Name：轨道显示名称。未传时默认为audio-{Language}。
AudioUrl：音频文件URL地址（OSS文件地址）
parameters.name: audio_tracks

parameters.help_en:
The list of subtitle tracks to be added, specified as a JSON string array. Each element contains:
Language: the subtitle language identifier. If not specified, the subtitle track is ignored.
SubtitleUrl: the URL of the subtitle file (WebVTT) (OSS file URL)
parameters.help_zh:
待添加的字幕轨道列表，JSON字符串数组。每个元素包含：
Language：字幕语言标识。未传时该条字幕会被忽略。
SubtitleUrl：字幕文件（WebVTT）URL地址（OSS文件地址）
parameters.name: subtitles

parameters.help_en:
The list of video tracks to be added, specified as a JSON string array. Each element contains:
Name: the display name of the track. If not specified, the video track is ignored.
VideoUrl: the URL of the video stream manifest file (OSS file URL)
parameters.help_zh:
待添加的视频轨道列表，JSON字符串数组。每个元素包含：
Name：轨道显示名称。未传时该条视频轨会被忽略。
VideoUrl：视频流清单文件URL地址（OSS文件地址）
parameters.name: video_tracks

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of tracks to be removed, specified as a JSON string. It contains:
AudioLanguages: the list of audio language identifiers for which the entire tracks are to be removed.
SubtitleLanguages: the list of subtitle language identifiers for which the entire tracks are to be removed
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的轨道配置，JSON字符串。包含：
AudioLanguages：需要按语言整轨删除的音频语言标识列表。
SubtitleLanguages：需要按语言整轨删除的字幕语言标识列表
parameters.name: remove_tracks

parameters.help_en:
The output configuration, specified as a JSON string. It contains:
OutputDir: the output directory. By default, it is the same directory as the source manifest.
ManifestName: the file name of the output master playlist. Default value: master. The .m3u8 suffix is not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
输出配置，JSON字符串。包含：
OutputDir：输出目录。默认与源manifest同目录。
ManifestName：输出的master播放列表文件名，默认值：master，不允许携带.m3u8后缀
parameters.name: output_config

ManifestEditJobId.description_en: The ID of the manifest editing task, which is the MediaConvert pipeline task ID
